notes.title: Patch notes Keltika Demo v0.2.3
notes.content:
Hello!

A small update to the demo version, adding new visual and sound effects.

Changelog

 Added new visual effects for swamps and the swamp drainage ritual
 Added a magical effect for the swamp drainage altar
 Added display of swamp level
 Fixed an issue with opening the load menu on some PCs

notes.title: Patch notes Keltika Demo v0.2.2
notes.content:
Hey!

Just a small update to the demo to make it more stable and performant.

Changelog

 Increased FPS up to 50%
 Reduced FPS drops during rain
 Reduced FPS drops during construction
 Fixed typos in the text
 Fixed the game crash issue at the end of training

notes.title: UPDATE v0.2
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who helps us find and fix issues with the demo! If you're having problems running the game, please don't hesitate to reach out!

TUTORIAL MODE

After a couple of very productive and challenging weeks we are very excited to present you our brand new Tutorial Mode!

We had a lot of feedback asking for some kind of guide to the game's rules and interface, and today we have finally polished it enough to add it with the latest update.

Also we worked really hard to fix common known issues to make the game more stable.

We at Rainy May Studio hope that you'll have a great time in Keltika!
